dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and continuous 2D narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with very high-key reflectance; subtle light grey/tan shading visible on the lateral flanks.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light grey/tan pigmentation along the lateral margins; no dense clusters of dark pixels are visible on the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the bright white central dorsal region and the slightly darker lateral edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Fine transverse skin creases are visible immediately posterior to the blowhole area.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct transverse epidermal folds located in the nuchal region posterior to the head.
